reviewItems.title: A key-file failure at startup exits silently (Nest abortOnError, logger false), and E11 cannot pass as written
The image HEALTHCHECK (docker/tea-ready.js, GET /v1.0.0/products) is permanently unhealthy under AUTH_MODE=required
Artifacts served by 302 to publisher URLs are not protected by required; threat model A1 and the docs must say so
Token refusals for a known key id are logged once per request, unbounded by unauthenticated clients
The key file is read into memory whole before its 64 KiB limit is checked
